TruTac Ltd.main_product: Tachograph analysis and fleet compliance software
TruTac Ltd.reason: TruTac's core focus and primary product line revolve around digital/analogue tachograph analysis and fleet compliance management (e.g., TruAnalysis, TruControl, TruChecks). While it offers real-time GPS vehicle tracking and remote tachograph downloading through its 'TruLocation' module, this capability is positioned as a feature or integration within its wider transport compliance and driver risk platform rather than being its standalone core product.
